name: MIS IEP History for a Prisoner
description: PDD0047 v00.00.01 Last Modified: 27/03/13 This report displays the IEP level history for a specified prisoner, for all bookings.

dataset.name: IEP History
dataset.query: dataset_base_ AS (SELECT AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.SURNAME, AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.FIRST_NAME, AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.MIDDLE_NAME_1, AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.GENDER_DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN AT_DOB.DAY_DATE <> '31/12/9000' THEN AT_DOB.DAY_DATE END AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.BOOKING_STATUS, AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.BOOKING_NUMBER, AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK, AT_BOOKING_START.DAY_DATE, AT_BOOKING_END_DATE.DAY_DATE AS OFFENDER_BOOKING_VALID_TO, AT_DIM_OFFENDER_IEP_LEVEL.IEP_LEVEL_SEQ, AT_DIM_OFFENDER_IEP_LEVEL.IEP_DATE_TIME, AT_DIM_OFFENDER_IEP_LEVEL.IEP_LEVEL, AT_IEP_ESTABLISHMENT.ESTABLISHMENT_DESCRIPTION, AT_DIM_OFFENDER_IEP_LEVEL.COMMENT_TEXT FROM BODIMIS.DIM_ESTABLISHMENT AT_IEP_ESTABLISHMENT, BODIMIS.DIM_OFFENDER_BOOKING AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING, BODIMIS.DIM_DATE AT_DOB, BODIMIS.DIM_DATE AT_BOOKING_START, BODIMIS.DIM_DATE AT_BOOKING_END_DATE, BODIMIS.DIM_OFFENDER_IEP_LEVEL AT_DIM_OFFENDER_IEP_LEVEL WHERE (AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.BIRTH_DATE_SK = AT_DOB.DATE_SK) AND (AT_BOOKING_START.DATE_SK = AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.BOOKING_BEGIN_DATE_SK) AND (AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.BOOKING_END_DATE_SK = AT_BOOKING_END_DATE.DATE_SK) AND (AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK IN (SELECT CSL.OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK FROM BODIMIS.DIM_STAFF_ACCESSIBLE_CASELOAD SAC, BODIMIS.DIM_CASELOAD_SECURITY_LIST CSL WHERE SAC.CASELOAD_ID = CSL.CASELOAD_CODE AND SAC.USERNAME = UPPER((SELECT username FROM context_ /* = #Variable('BOUSER') */)) AND (CSL.ENDYEAR >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYY') - 6 OR CSL.ENDYEAR = '2999'))) AND (AT_DIM_OFFENDER_IEP_LEVEL.OFFENDER_BOOK_ID_NK (+) = AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.OFFENDER_BOOKING_ID_NK) AND (AT_IEP_ESTABLISHMENT.ESTABLISHMENT_SK = AT_DIM_OFFENDER_IEP_LEVEL.ESTABLISHMENT_SK) AND (AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY = (SELECT PRISONER_NUMBER FROM prompt_ /* = #Prompt('Enter NOMS Number',,,mono,free,Not_Persistent,User:1) */))), dataset_ AS (SELECT OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, SURNAME, FIRST_NAME, MIDDLE_NAME_1, GENDER_DESCRIPTION, DATE_OF_BIRTH, BOOKING_STATUS, BOOKING_NUMBER, OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK, DAY_DATE, OFFENDER_BOOKING_VALID_TO, IEP_LEVEL_SEQ, IEP_DATE_TIME, IEP_LEVEL, ESTABLISHMENT_DESCRIPTION, COMMENT_TEXT FROM dataset_base_)

dataset.name: MIS Load Log
dataset.query: dataset_base_ AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRUNC(BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG.LOAD_END_DATETIME) AS LOAD_END_DATE FROM BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG WHERE (BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG.LOAD_ID = (SELECT MAX(LOAD_ID) FROM BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG WHERE NOT LOAD_END_DATETIME IS NULL))), dataset_ AS (SELECT LOAD_END_DATE FROM dataset_base_)
